nodes.description: address public owner - set to msg.sender in Owned constructor, gates onlyOwner functions
address public newOwner - pending owner for two-step ownership transfer
bool public paused = false - emergency stop flag checked by whenNotPaused/whenPaused
string public symbol set to 'CL+' in the token constructor
string public name set to 'CITYLIFE PLUS Token'
uint8 public decimals = 18
uint public _totalSupply = 1000000000 * 10**18 minted to owner
mapping(address => uint) balances - token balance ledger
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed - ERC20 allowance ledger
library SafeMath.add - c = a + b with require(c >= a)
library SafeMath.sub - require(b <= a) then c = a - b
library SafeMath.mul - c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
library SafeMath.div - require(b > 0) then c = a / b
Owned() constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
onlyOwner - stages newOwner = _newOwner
require(msg.sender == newOwner); finalizes transfer and zeroes newOwner
onlyOwner whenNotPaused - sets paused = true and emits Pause
onlyOwner whenPaused - sets paused = false and emits Unpause
ERC20 constructor - sets metadata, total supply and mints to owner
returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
returns balances[tokenOwner]
whenNotPaused ERC20 transfer using SafeMath add/sub on balances
sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens
SafeMath.add applied to allowed[msg.sender][spender]
SafeMath.sub applied to allowed[msg.sender][spender], clamped to zero
whenNotPaused transferFrom checking balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender]
returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
whenNotPaused - approves spender then calls spender.receiveApproval (external callback)
payable fallback that immediately reverts - contract rejects ETH
onlyOwner whenNotPaused - external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens)
msg.sender - untrusted caller used for ownership checks, balances and allowances
SafeMath.add arithmetic a + b evaluated before the overflow require
SafeMath.sub arithmetic a - b evaluated after require(b <= a)
SafeMath.mul arithmetic a * b evaluated before the overflow require
constructor arithmetic 1000000000 * 10**uint(decimals) producing _totalSupply
external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data)
external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary contract
address to - recipient argument of transfer
uint tokens - amount argument of transfer
address spender - approval and callback target of approveAndCall
uint tokens - approved amount argument of approveAndCall
uint oldValue - cached current allowance in decreaseApproval

edges.reason: SafeMath.add computes a + b before verifying the result is not smaller than a
SafeMath.sub computes a - b, guarded only by require(b <= a)
SafeMath.mul computes a * b with a post-hoc division overflow check
Owned constructor reads msg.sender to initialise the owner
constructor writes owner = msg.sender
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before staging new newOwner
transferOwnership writes newOwner = _newOwner
acceptOwnership gates execution on require(msg.sender == newOwner)
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0)
pause is restricted by onlyOwner (msg.sender == owner)
pause writes paused = true
unpause is restricted by onlyOwner (msg.sender == owner)
unpause writes paused = false
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before pausing
whenPaused modifier requires paused before unpausing
token constructor reads owner to credit the entire supply
constructor assigns symbol = 'CL+'
constructor assigns name = 'CITYLIFE PLUS Token'
constructor assigns decimals = 18
constructor assigns _totalSupply = 1000000000 * 10**decimals
constructor writes balances[owner] = _totalSupply
constructor performs unchecked multiplication/exponentiation for the supply
totalSupply reads _totalSupply
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner]
transfer debits and credits using msg.sender as the source account
transfer writes sender and recipient entries in balances
transfer calls SafeMath.sub on the sender balance
transfer calls SafeMath.add on the recipient balance
whenNotPaused modifier blocks transfer while paused
transfer uses the recipient parameter as destination
transfer uses the tokens parameter as transferred amount
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens
increaseApproval operates on the msg.sender allowance entry
increaseApproval writes the increased allowance into allowed
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the allowance
decreaseApproval operates on the msg.sender allowance entry
decreaseApproval writes the reduced allowance into allowed
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on the allowance
decreaseApproval caches allowed[msg.sender][spender] in oldValue before branching
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the approved spender
transferFrom writes balances[from] and balances[to]
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender]
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub on balance and allowance
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add on the recipient balance
whenNotPaused modifier blocks transferFrom while paused
allowance reads the allowed mapping
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the approving owner
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a caller-supplied contract, handing control to external code
approveAndCall uses the spender parameter as approval and callback target
approveAndCall uses the tokens parameter as the approved amount
whenNotPaused modifier blocks approveAndCall while paused
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner (msg.sender == owner)
transferAnyERC20Token sends the rescued tokens to owner
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into a caller-supplied token contract
whenNotPaused modifier blocks transferAnyERC20Token while paused

normalization_plan.reason: the recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer function and carries no independent semantics
the amount parameter is consumed solely by the transfer balance updates and SafeMath calls
the spender parameter is used only to key the allowance entry and to select the approval callback target
the tokens parameter only supplies the approved amount in approveAndCall
oldValue is a transient cache of allowed[msg.sender][spender] local to decreaseApproval
